notes:
- Settings has a new home inside the app, in the same style as the rest of the new look. Click the cog as before.
- Try a colour or an angle and watch it on the model you have open before you save. You can drag the model round to choose the angle.
- Everything is in sections down the left: Previews, New Models, Tag Ideas, Your Printers and This App.
- It tells you what you've changed and haven't saved yet. Save changes keeps them; Cancel puts things back.
